pages.quiz:
SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.

2. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.
   B. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.
   B. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.

4. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.
   D. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Avoiding all community work

6. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.
   B. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   D. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   C. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.

8. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nakuru
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

9. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

10. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   C. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.

11. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing The School.
   C. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat The School as rumours only.

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise Project at School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Peace and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Child Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Democracy in school and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
